'''2006 Coruscant Regionals''' was a Star Wars CCG regional played on 29 April 2006 in Pennsylvania. The [[Players Committee]] billed it as the biggest Pennsylvania Star Wars CCG event of 29 April, with details in a thread on its forums.<ref name="pc-sid2">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=2 Coruscant Regional - This Weekend!], swccgpc.com (27 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617220003/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]] [[Release Your Anger (V)]] carries the credit line "Original concept by [[Nate Meeker]], Coruscant Regionals 2006".<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 64. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Nate Meeker]] and [[Jonny Chu|Jon Chu]] qualified for the [[2006 World Championship]] at the Coruscant Regional.<ref name="pcf-9443-130633">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=130633#130633 Qualifiers for Worlds 2006], Michael Carr (mc9457), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618055549/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141112 Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Michael Carr]] announced the event on 3 April 2006 for Six Feet Under Games in Lancaster, Pennsylvania: six games starting at 11 AM, a $10 entry fee and a guaranteed $100 cash prize for first place that grew with attendance. An Ultimate prize package had been bought for it, with booster packs, tournament foils, a virtual card design and DeckTech.net premium memberships. Decklists were mandatory, and the final four played an elimination confrontation. A four-game V-Lite consolation tournament followed at 5 PM, included in the entry fee, with a V-Lite card design for its winner.<ref name="sf-9441-130628" /> The same store had hosted a Pennsylvania Open Last Minute Qualifier the year before.<ref name="sf-9441-131064">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=131064#p131064 Coruscant Regional & V-Lite Tournament Weekend - 4/29], mc9457 (Michael Carr), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (6 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125144835/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=9441 Internet Archive]</ref> On 27 April Carr wrote that the shopping center had pulled the store's lease to make room for an Aeropostale, so the day of the regional would be the store's last day of business. He added that clear sleeves were illegal and that the final four would play match play.<ref name="sf-9441-133857" />

[[Jonny Chu|Jon Chu]], [[Jason Foss]], [[Aaron Kingery]] and [[Mike d'Amboise|Mike D'amboise]] were to represent Team Albany.<ref name="sf-9441-133914">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=133914#p133914 Coruscant Regional & V-Lite Tournament Weekend - 4/29], Archmage (Aaron Kingery), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (27 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125144835/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=9441 Internet Archive]</ref> On the day, 20 players from Ohio, Pennsylvania, New York, West Virginia, Maryland and Virginia attended. The decks played were Scum, TRM, Profit, Agents of the Black Sun, Hunt Down, CR Dueling, CR Bespin, Ralltiir, BHBM, QMC, CP Tatooine, Walkers, CP Endor, SYCFear, MWYHL, WYS (V), Watto and LS LSC; the most popular were WYS (V), Scum, CR Bespin, CP Endor and CP Tatooine.<ref name="sf-9441-134222" /> In the first round [[Drew Scott]] beat [[James Booker]] by 22 in a rematch of their [[2005 World Championship]] final. After the first round the top four were [[Tim Simon]], [[Bill Kafer]], Drew Scott and [[Steve Yaeger]].<ref name="sf-9441-134227">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=134227#p134227 Coruscant Regional & V-Lite Tournament Weekend - 4/29], mc9457 (Michael Carr), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125144835/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=9441 Internet Archive]</ref> After the second round they were Jonathon Chu, Kafer, [[Nate Meeker]] and Steven Yaeger, with one player still undefeated.<ref name="sf-9441-134233">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=134233#p134233 Coruscant Regional & V-Lite Tournament Weekend - 4/29], mc9457 (Michael Carr), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125144835/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=9441 Internet Archive]</ref> Carr's live updates stop there. In August 2006 [[Brad Eier]] wrote that Meeker had taken first place and Chu second, and that he himself had finished ahead of Aaron Kingery and Mike d'Amboise in the V-Lite event.<ref name="sf-11373-155722">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=155722#p155722 Some Nationals Smack Talk], The Franchise (Brad Eier), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (8 August 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125171352/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t11373-start20.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Pennsylvania<ref name="pc-sid2" /> (Six Feet Under Games, 2481 Lincoln Highway East, Lancaster)<ref name="sf-9441-130628">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=130628#p130628 Coruscant Regional & V-Lite Tournament Weekend - 4/29], mc9457 (Michael Carr), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (3 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125144835/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=9441 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 29 April 2006<ref name="pc-sid2" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-9441-130628" />
* '''Players:''' 20<ref name="sf-9441-134222">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=134222#p134222 Coruscant Regional & V-Lite Tournament Weekend - 4/29], mc9457 (Michael Carr), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125144835/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=9441 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Structure:''' six games, then a final four elimination played as match play; a four-game V-Lite consolation tournament from 5 PM<ref name="sf-9441-130628" /><ref name="sf-9441-133857">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=133857#p133857 Coruscant Regional & V-Lite Tournament Weekend - 4/29], mc9457 (Michael Carr), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (27 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125144835/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=9441 Internet Archive]</ref>
